customers.description: One row per unique customer identifier. Stores who placed orders, their city, state and zip prefix.

sellers.description: One row per seller that lists products on the marketplace. Includes location (city, state, zip prefix).

products.description: One row per product. Includes product category and physical attributes (weight and dimensions).

product_category_translation.description: Translates Portuguese product category names to English. Join to products on product_category_name.

orders.description: One row per customer order. Includes order status, purchase timestamp, approval timestamp and delivery timestamps.

order_items.description: One row per item within an order. Links an order to a product and seller, with unit price and freight value.

order_payments.description: One row per payment instalment of an order. Includes payment type, number of instalments and value.

order_reviews.description: One row per customer review of an order. Includes a 1-5 review score and optional comment text.

geolocation.description: Geolocation (lat/long, city, state) keyed by zip prefix. Used as a dimensional lookup; has no unique key.

order_items.price.description: Unit price in BRL for one item line, excluding freight.

order_items.freight_value.description: Freight/shipping charge in BRL for the item line.

orders.order_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order (created, approved, shipped, delivered, canceled, unavailable, ...).

orders.order_purchase_timestamp.description: When the customer placed the order.

orders.order_estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date promised to the customer.

order_payments.payment_value.description: Monetary value of one payment instalment.

order_payments.payment_type.description: Payment method used (credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card, not_defined).
